info.title: NYALES M2 implemented local API
info.description: Implementation slice /api. Full /api/v1 product contract remains design. Local acceptance only; no cloud deployment. JSON request shapes generated from Zod runtime schemas; cross-field/permission/calendar/amount/state constraints enforced by server and regression tests. Responses intentionally use variable data envelope, not a fully typed SDK response contract. Read scope applies organization/area/hierarchy/channel/assignment; settings Management/NSM; order and target approvals independent. Monetary minor fields are whole IDR rupiah.

parameters.description: Resource-specific filter applied before pagination; requires limit. Unsupported combinations return 422.

200.description: Legacy data array when limit is omitted. With limit: data contains at most limit rows; meta.pagination={limit,offset,has_more,consistency:"live_offset"}. One sentinel row is read; no exact count. Activities order occurred_at DESC,id DESC; plans/tasks/handoffs by scheduled/due time,id; sessions/exceptions by time DESC,id DESC. Mutation during traversal may shift offsets; not an immutable export.

get.x-pagination: SQL LIMIT limit+1 OFFSET offset, scope and optional status/channel/activity_kind predicates before paging; active/ended session status is own-user only. activity_kind applies only to activities; exceptions do not accept channel; plan channel maps field→visit/telesales→call.
